title: dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ariyasaccaṃ
titleEn: The Noble Truth of the Way
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
“Now this, bhikkhus, is the noble truth of the way leading to the cessation of dukkha:
it is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
right view, right intention,
right speech, right action, right livelihood,
right effort, right awareness, right concentration.”
